assignments.evidence: Only after ryu (Isis): 'ryu knjq fp', also split as 'kn jq fp'; kn 'god' + njq 'woman' + fp 'great' = great goddess.
njq 'woman' + the kin ending -bt (as in ubt 'mother'); 'htfkyu xjofqw NAME njqbt fy rq' = 'is the sister of the general'.
'NAME wkfyrq' follows a man's name in filiations (90x); 'ubt fq gyat wk fy' = mother of the king, wife of ...; reads 'sem'.
Office title with district modifiers: 'htfkyu xjofqw' (of the province), 'htfkyu xbyfqb' (of the water, xby); reads 'pelmos'.
Joins list items: 'vfoq 3 jqkt 4 ntfr ...', 'stj bfb 16 ntfr ...', and 'ntfr stbkjtotbyrq' adds one more kin relation at the end of a list.
A personal title in funerary filiations ('stbkjtfyrq uuya kew kfqbyrq') and 'uuya fp fy rq' = 'is chief/great X'; reads 'ssor'.
Counted beside jqkt 'cow': 'vfoq 3 jqkt 4 ntfr ...' = 3 X, 4 cows.
Royal title: 'RNAME gyatfp', 'bjvt RNAME gyatb', opens royal stelae ('gyat bmsqjxkxeq'), 'ubt fq gyat' = king's mother; reads 'qore'.
Opens 34 short votive graffiti in a fixed formula 'btrqwbq xat nt NAME stuyx' (proskynema); reads 'tewisti'.
Rare kin word in royal narratives ('rqjt fy' = is brother); male counterpart of njqbt, with the kin ending -jt as in stbkjt; reads 'wide'.
Only in the long royal stela, in a religious context: 'ew ew f gya ...', 'ew ew f xkeh ...' (for the king, for Amun of Napata); cf. animals listed with 'eu' in 'vfoq 3 jqkt 4 ntfr gt eu hta'.
Short form of the mother's half of filiation: 'NAME btjvtfyrq NAME btaqntfyrq' (born of ... begotten by), also 'NAME bjvtfyrq'; reads 'tdhe'.
Most frequent kin word, repeated down long genealogies of officials ('NAME stbkjtfyrq ... stbkjtfyrq'); shares staqnt's prefix; reads 'yetmde'.
Office title: 'xhybt xaykt fq w NAME' (envoy to Rome, arome), 'xhybt fp' (great envoy); reads 'apote'.
Only in one royal text, in geographic narrative ('par xjyeqfqntbt sqatgr xar ...'); related 'sqatnt fy' follows 'xnqfqnr' (Akine, Lower Nubia), so it is a direction word.
Paired with xby 'water' in the offering formula: 'xby kpt hquqptntw xb kpt hquqvantw' = abundant water ..., abundant bread ...
'xkeqw kbt fy' = 'is the child of Amun' (royal epithet); 'kbt njq' = female child; 'kbt htfkyu xbyfqb staqnt fy' = child begotten by the general; reads 'mte'.
